title: koeleria lagopoides
intro: Koeleria lagopoides, commonly known as June grass, is a perennial grass species native to Europe, Asia, and North America. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion, as well as its therapeutic actions such as promoting diuresis and treating coughs. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and safety of Koeleria lagopoides as a medicinal plant.
